frozen_candidate_root_contribution: baED is a relational partitive nominal designating an unspecified PROPER (non-total) PART / SUBSET of an identified whole - 'some of / a portion of / one of (several)' - that presupposes a larger whole, stands complementary to a remainder, and is inherently less than the totality (kull). Quantity and identity of the portion are left indeterminate; the whole may be a mass, an abstract, a time-span, a scripture, produce, or an enumerable plurality. Its reciprocal / distributive reading ('one another', 'some ... others') is compositional doubling of the same partitive across a predicate, not a second lexical sense.

internal_discovery.plain_explanation: In 157 of 158 occurrences baED means 'part of / some of / one of' a stated whole - always less than all, with the size and which-member left vague. When it is repeated (baED ... baED) it simply splits one whole into two interacting portions, and the surrounding verb (favour, enmity, alliance, whispering, wronging) supplies the relation; baED itself only ever contributes 'a portion of'. The single remaining token, baEuwDap 'a gnat' at 2:26, is a concrete creature-name that shares only the consonantal skeleton and carries no partitive meaning, so it is treated as a separate lexeme and is not folded into the claim.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: baED does NOT entail: the whole/all (it is the standing complement of kull and always entails a remainder - 18:19 yawman aw baEDa yawmin, 2:85 bibaEDi l-kitaabi ... wa-takfuruuna bibaEDin, 66:3 Earrafa baEDahu wa-aEraDa Ean baEDin); a fixed quantity or proportion (neutral between one member, 66:3:5:1 baEDi azwaajihi, and many); SMALLNESS (it marks proportion/partition, not size - baEDa l-laði naEiduhum may be a large threat); evaluative polarity (neutral: favoured prophets 17:55 and wrongdoers set over one another 6:129); animacy/concreteness of the whole; reciprocity (never in the single word, only produced by doubling); independent reference (it never denotes a self-standing entity - which is precisely why 2:26 baEuwDap, a self-standing creature, cannot belong to this class).
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: At 2:26:9:1 baEuwDapF (baEuwDap, 'a gnat') is a concrete count-noun of a different morphological pattern (faEuwlap, feminine, taa marbuutap + tanwiin, medial waaw) naming a whole creature used as the object of yaDrib maθalan and scaled against famaa fawqahaa; it exhibits zero partitive/subset function and presupposes no whole, so no Quran-internal bridge links it to the baED partitive nucleus.
internal_discovery.strongest_competitor: The strongest competing unification is an abstract single-nucleus 'a small / discrete / minimal portion or unit' that would absorb baEuwDap 'gnat' as 'a tiny thing' alongside baED 'a portion'. It is rejected because (a) it depends on etymological/lexical priors the source policy forbids; (b) Quran-internally baEuwDap shows zero portion/subset content - it is a named creature in a similitude scaled against 'what is above it'; and (c) an abstraction wide enough to cover both 'some of the revealed signs' and 'a gnat' is a vacuous over-fit and would wrongly import a 'small' entailment that baED demonstrably lacks. A secondary competitor - that baED lexicalizes 'each other' - is refuted by 2:85 / 4:150 / 66:3 where doubling yields non-reciprocal partition. The narrower two-item description (one partitive nucleus + one lexicalized homonym) is more honest and more predictive.

internal_discovery.rationale: All three lenses independently read the packet in full (158 occ, 100% POS=N, no verbal derivation) and converged: 157 tokens are case/orthographic inflections of one partitive nominal baED whose 'proper-part-of-a-whole' account is broad, distinctive across every domain (persons, plants 13:4, layered darkness 24:40, time 18:19, speech 69:44, scripture 2:85, promises 40:77, sins 5:49), and adversarially clean with no resistant sub-class internally - a STRONG profile for that lexeme alone. The reciprocal/distributive doubling is shown to be compositional (the same doubling yields both 'one another' and non-reciprocal 'part vs part' at 2:85/4:150/66:3), so it is not a second sense. The lone token baEuwDap 'gnat' (2:26:9:1) is a lexicalized concrete nominal of a distinct pattern with no Quran-internal bridge to the partitive nucleus. Per the contract, a resistant lexicalized/nominal sub-class filed under the same root_id caps a whole-root single-gloss claim at MODERATE + REPRESENTATIVE; we therefore issue a PREFERRED representative claim over the dominant lexeme WITHOUT forcing the gnat into one nucleus, and flag 2:26 as an unbridged separate lexeme.

resistant_deep_analysis.preliminary_note: baEuwDapF (2:26:9:1) is a distinct morphological pattern (faEuwlap, feminine, taa marbuutap + tanwiin, medial waaw) unlike the faEl quantifier baED; it is filed under root_id bED only because the triliteral skeleton is recoverable. It names a specific animal, is scaled against famaa fawqahaa, never doubles, and takes no genitive whole. No Quran-internal evidence bridges 'gnat' to 'proper part of a whole', so it stands as an unbridged homonymous lexeme.
resistant_deep_analysis.reconciliation_rationale: On inspection baEuwDap is a distinct faEuwlap pattern with concrete creature meaning and zero partitive function; all three lenses agree it is an unbridged lexicalized homonym. It is held OUT of the partitive nucleus rather than diluting it, and caps the whole-root claim at MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE.

independent_verification: Three independent lenses (A, B, adversary C) each read all 158 occurrences and converged on the same nucleus, the same compositional analysis of doubling, and the same single unbridged outlier.
candidate_root_contribution: baED is a relational partitive nominal designating an unspecified PROPER (non-total) PART / SUBSET of an identified whole - 'some of / a portion of / one of (several)' - that presupposes a larger whole, stands complementary to a remainder, and is inherently less than the totality (kull). Quantity and identity of the portion are left indeterminate; the whole may be a mass, an abstract, a time-span, a scripture, produce, or an enumerable plurality. Its reciprocal / distributive reading ('one another', 'some ... others') is compositional doubling of the same partitive across a predicate, not a second lexical sense.

layer_attribution.occurrence_evidence: 158 QAC-confirmed tokens, 100% POS=N/form=N; 157 are case/state inflections of the faEl partitive baED, 1 is baEuwDap (2:26:9:1) of pattern faEuwlap; b~aEoDu (49:12) and baEoDF[A (6:129) are tajwiid/orthographic artifacts.
layer_attribution.derivation: No verbal, participial, adjectival, or plural derivation exists in the corpus; the root's attested behaviour is one near-frozen partitive nominal plus one homonymous concrete noun - a shallow/grammaticalized field, not a radiating derivational family.
layer_attribution.lexical_class: Two distinct lexemes under one root_id: (i) baED, a relational partitive quantifier-noun requiring a genitive whole or a paired second baED; (ii) baEuwDap, a lexicalized concrete count-noun 'gnat'. They are homonymous, not two senses of one lexeme.
layer_attribution.contextual_relation: Reciprocal/enmity/favour/alliance/whispering meanings (e.g. 2:36 baEDukum libaEDin Eaduww, 9:71 awliyaaEu baED, 4:34 faDDala baEDahum Ealaa baED) are supplied by the surrounding predicate and the doubling construction, NOT by baED; these contextual/narrative relations must not be promoted into the root claim.
layer_attribution.reconciliation: The preliminary temptation to fold 2:26 into the uniform POS=N class, and to treat doubled baED as a separate 'each-other' sense, were both rejected on Quran-internal grounds; 2:26 is held out as RESISTANT and doubling is reconciled as compositional partition (2:85/4:150/66:3).
layer_attribution.unresolved_resistance: baEuwDap 'gnat' (2:26:9:1) remains an unbridged lexicalized nominal with no Quran-internal link to the partitive nucleus; it caps the whole-root claim at MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE and is the sole persisted resistant occurrence.

hard_cases.reason: Sole non-partitive token; lexicalized concrete noun 'a gnat' of a distinct morphological pattern with no Quran-internal bridge to the partitive nucleus - blocks any single universal root account.

evidence_basis.statement: At 2:26:9:1 baEuwDapF (baEuwDap, 'a gnat') is a concrete count-noun of a different morphological pattern (faEuwlap, feminine, taa marbuutap + tanwiin, medial waaw) naming a whole creature used as the object of yaDrib maθalan and scaled against famaa fawqahaa; it exhibits zero partitive/subset function and presupposes no whole, so no Quran-internal bridge links it to the baED partitive nucleus.

hard_case_representation.rationale: There is a well-supported PREFERRED claim over the dominant partitive lexeme (157/158); the single resistant token baEuwDap is represented as an evidence-derived RESISTANT_SEAM (morphological + distributional divergence) rather than being forced into the nucleus or triggering full non-resolution.

rejection_condition.challenging_finding: A Quranic occurrence where baED (the faEl partitive) denotes something OTHER than a proper non-total part of a presupposed whole - e.g. baED lexically meaning 'all/entirety', or intrinsically entailing SMALLNESS, or functioning as a self-standing referent with no whole and no complementary remainder; OR positive Quran-internal evidence that baEuwDap (2:26) is construed as 'a small part/portion', which would bridge the gnat to the nucleus.
rejection_condition.search_location: All 157 partitive tokens (esp. construct+genitive and doubled baED ... baED cases such as 2:85, 4:150, 66:3, 24:40, 6:129) and the isolated 2:26:9:1; check co-text for kull-contrast, remainder entailment, and any size predication.
rejection_condition.verification_method: Re-read each candidate verse_text and its QAC morphology (qac_surface_form_buckwalter, form) Quran-internally only; confirm whether a whole is presupposed and a remainder entailed, and whether baEuwDap ever takes a partitive complement or doubles.
rejection_condition.confounder_control: Exclude tajwiid/orthographic artifacts (b~aEoDu 49:12 idghaam, baEoDF[A 6:129 iqlaab) as pseudo-variants; do not import lexical/etymological priors to manufacture a gnat-to-partition bridge; distinguish the compositional relation contributed by the predicate from any claimed lexical content of baED.
rejection_condition.failure_consequence: If baED is shown to mean 'all' or to entail smallness, or a self-standing non-partitive baED token is found, the partitive nucleus account is falsified and must be re-scoped; if 2:26 is Quran-internally bridged as 'a small part', the two-lexeme split collapses toward a single graded nucleus and the grading must be revisited upward in scope.

reopen_conditions: Reopen if any partitive baED token (esp. within doubled baED ... baED at 2:85, 4:150, 66:3, or the faDDala ... baEDahum Ealaa baED series 2:253/4:34/17:21/43:32) is shown to entail totality, fixed proportion, or intrinsic smallness rather than an indeterminate remainder-bearing portion.

Reopen if Quran-internal evidence emerges that baEuwDap (2:26:9:1) is construed as 'a small part/portion' (bridging gnat to the partitive nucleus), or if any further baED-root token of a non-faEl pattern appears that shares partitive function - either would force revisiting the two-lexeme split.
Reopen if a self-standing baED with no presupposed whole and no complementary remainder is identified, contradicting the relational/partitive core.

falsification_evidence.status_rationale: The partitive account is falsifiable (it predicts a presupposed whole + remainder and excludes 'all'/smallness) and is distinctive against kull, the partitive preposition min (cf. 3:195/4:25/9:67 baEDukum min baEDin combining both), and faction-nouns fariiq/Taaifap. Across the 157 nucleus tokens no occurrence resists. A full adversarial refutation was NOT run to PASSED because one lexicalized nominal (baEuwDap 2:26) resists as an unbridged homonym; per contract this is recorded rather than treated as core failure.
